entities.summary: Hamamat Montia is a Ghanaian model, entrepreneur and cultural advocate. She is a former Miss Miss Malaika queen and Model of Africa Universe. Beyond modeling, she is known for promoting Ghana’s shea butter industry, founding the Shea Butter Museum, and supporting women-led production in northern Ghana.
